title: Episode 22
logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 21 where Prudence revealed that the Dowager Duchess is dying from a mysterious illness; Juliana sets aside her aristocratic identity to sneak into Ashbury Manor under the guise of domestic help to save her.
